oneContinuityPlan.description: Continuous quarry-bank supported mechanical transmission along outside of original B48 right-bank from local t≈-360 to +45, ending near TRUE B51-14 mechanical rotator. Original camera/road/obstacles/240Hz unchanged; noncolliding scenic candidate only.

alternativeASlab.name: Single continuous tall roadside mechanical enclosure, 4.6m high, with an amber top trace and unequal quarry support braces
alternativeASlab.visually: The projected form is a giant flat orange opaque wall with long boring horizontal band occupying x632..958 and y296..412 at 66.35s, recalling prior ART-rejected slabs and falsely implying a roadside facility. Source road and moving B51 context would be visually weakened.

alternativeBOpenTruss.name: Same functional continuum, no enclosing slab, two thin separated structural chords, one exposed transmission rod, three unequal founded quarry braces. One within-scope structural revision, not a new waterfall topic.
alternativeBOpenTruss.meaning: Projected right-bank line segments are largely not occluded by existing geometry, but at original chase camera they read as thin cyan/yellow dotted wiring against many quarry strata. There is no intelligible machine load path or obvious causal connection to true moving B51. Numeric visibility cannot be ART GO.

criticalDecision.sourceRealArt: NO NEW BLENDER OR NATIVE GL / source image is authentic but candidate is CPU illustration
criticalDecision.criticalInsight: Trying to make an early directional approach visually substantial reproduces the old wall; keeping it nonintrusive collapses into a few thin cables that do not communicate the real mechanical hazard. Both are not good enough for ART-first paid-indie quality.
criticalDecision.notExhaustive: Only one road-bank arrangement with broad solid versus open-web structural revision and three 66.25-66.55 original cameras. Does NOT prove all B51 approaches or native Blender art impossible. Early 65.25 camera not analyzed here.
criticalDecision.nextGate: Stop right-bank slabs and tiny cables, generic props and new numbered diagnostic CI. R60 should first define a SINGLE visibly different recognizable supported machine at actual hazard and its natural advance warning within the existing road/sightline, without requiring fake safe path or altering original protected 8, B51, road or camera. A genuine original camera early-window (at >=1.5 seconds) must show meaningful silhouette and causal motion BEFORE Blender. If fixed constraints preclude recognizable art, preserve HOLD and present concrete reason rather than claim success.
